rootCauses.viewportCode: ComboViewport.updateBar (478-495) writes the logical bar only when barState == BAR_SET (480). But barState follows the window's native operations, not the stock list. add() (943-954) advances it only for an insert that lands in the window. plan.inserted returns -1 for appends after the window (VirtualRowWindowPlan.java:140-155), so after reset only the first add counts: barState is BAR_DEFAULT with a window of 0+1. Window maintenance is counted instead: insertNative 345, deleteNative 351, and setSingleState 434. deleteRows (994-1006) counts only resident removals. setItems sets BAR_NONE (1100) although stock adds every item. The stale cover() puts the pre-patch value back after the window build (218/221). The dropped list therefore keeps the native window's own bar 0..100 (101 rows).
rootCauses.fix: Make barState a logical lane of the stock list box. (1) add() calls inserted() once for every logical insert, resident or not, closed or dropped. It inserts natively only when entry >= 0 && !stale. (2) insertNative() and the empty-row inserts in setSingleState stop calling inserted(). (3) deleteNative() stops setting BAR_SET, and deleteRows() sets BAR_SET for every removal. (4) setItems() sets `barState = items.length == 0 ? BAR_NONE : items.length == 1 ? BAR_DEFAULT : BAR_SET`. After this, the save and restore in cover() at 218/221 has no effect. The hunks are '@@ -86', '@@ -342', '@@ -431', '@@ -941', '@@ -992' and '@@ -1097' in scratch proposed-ComboViewport.diff.
